script:
proposal=json.loads((p.OUT/'proposal.json').read_text())
raw=p.instrument(proposal['cases'],'diff3','consistent_pair',.02)
try:
 raw.reset();ref,log=raw._role_buffers;table,monitor,error,mask=raw._gyro_buffers
 args=control_args(raw)
 wp.launch(p.prepare,raw.num_envs,[0,2,args[12],args[0],args[2],args[7],args[6],raw.state,args[5],ref,log])
 wp.launch(p.noise.before_control,raw.num_envs,[0,args[2],args[7],raw.state,args[6],args[5],0,table.shape[1],monitor,error])
 args[12]=ref;wp.launch(p.experimental.control_physical_nominal,raw.num_envs,args,block_dim=32)
 wp.launch(p.finish,raw.num_envs,[0,raw.diag,log]);wp.launch(p.noise.filtered_measurement,raw.num_envs,[0,raw.k['state'],monitor])
 sensor=raw.data.sensordata.numpy();sensor[:,int(raw.ids.numpy()[10])+2]=0.;raw.data.sensordata.assign(sensor)
 wp.launch(p.noise.fresh_measurement,raw.num_envs,[0,raw.data.sensordata,raw.ids,raw.state,raw.active,table,1,monitor,error])
 trace,tracking,count,*_=raw._complete_buffers
 values=np.zeros(trace.shape);values[0,0,:4]=[1,1,0,.0005];trace.assign(values)
 counts=np.zeros(count.shape);counts[0]=[1,1];count.assign(counts)
 state=raw.state.numpy();state[0,0]=1;raw.state.assign(state)
 done=raw.done.numpy();done[0]=5;raw.done.assign(done)
 result=raw.step_wait();assert raw._role_frozen==raw._gyro_frozen==raw._complete_frozen=={0}
 assert not raw._role_chunks[0] and result[3][0]['complete_counts']==dict(steps=1,contacts=0)
 done=raw.done.numpy();done[0]=5;raw.done.assign(done);raw.step_wait();assert raw._role_frozen=={0}
 raw.reset();assert not raw._role_frozen and not log.numpy().any() and not ref.numpy().any()
 assert not raw.state.numpy()[:,0].any() and not raw.data.time.numpy().any()
finally:raw.close()
